extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.0 - For BingeTV's new skin: the player's Streams button picks another stream for what's playing and carries on where you were; autoplay skips a stream that turns out to be a short "can't play" clip and tries the next; the preparing page stays up from start to finish; a Home rows editor; extra hubs on the menu bar. Similar titles use your meta addon. Kodi 21 and Arctic Zephyr Stremio work as before. v0.16.4 - Ready for Kodi 22's faster add-on start-up (the interpreter kept between calls, which BingeTV turns on): the library export follows a profile switch, and the watchlist's Add/Remove in menus catches up with changes made elsewhere within a minute. Nothing changes on Kodi 21.
